task_summary: Parse a Three.js createScene() file to extract part-level structure, exporting individual meshes per part and merged part assemblies as OBJ files.
decomposition_rationale: The task is cohesive—parse a Three.js scene in headless Node.js and export OBJs in two structured forms. A single skill covering headless execution, scene traversal, and OBJ export keeps related logic together without artificial separation.

skills.name: evo-threejs-scene-parser
skills.description: Parse a Three.js createScene() file in headless Node.js, identify part-level structure (Groups and standalone Meshes), and export OBJ files for both individual sub-meshes per part and merged part assemblies (links). Use when extracting decomposed 3D object structure from Three.js scene definitions.
skills.responsibility: Headless Three.js execution, scene graph traversal/classification, world-matrix resolution, per-mesh and merged-part OBJ export with the required output directory layout.
